title: Reel wrap-up and Joe Mares
summary: Allen asks if Bergen has energy to continue; Bergen jokes about Joe Mares and his brother's style; transcript degrades.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: And I get the little Louie, throwing it on the Louie Tones. You got energy enough for one mower?
You got enough questions? I don't know if I have enough questions, huh?
But we can get a little bit of it in anyway. I didn't think we'd get this far, man.
What does Joe Morazz call me, honey? I made him mad one night up at the jazz club. You know I call you. Joe Morazz calls me, we the people. We the people.

He never stops. I'm not worried about that. I'll drop in and see him once in a while, Dick. If you don't play like his brother, you don't play it right. He tells the guys what he wants when he has it. Dick, when he has a record made. D dear
